description: tiktok-shop: Product Reviews. GET /v1/tiktok/shop/product/reviews. Provide one of: url, product_id. The first page of a US TikTok Shop product's reviews (up to 5), with total_reviews and the star breakdown. First page only. A product with no reviews costs 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when product_reviews is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

page.description: Only 1 is accepted: later pages are not available.

product_id.description: The product id. Required if url is not provided.

url.description: The product URL. Required if product_id is not provided.

name: tiktok_shop_product_reviews
